where.title: Technical details
where.footer: Data stays in this browser profile and origin. To move it, export here and import there.

ios.body: Export before using Add to Home Screen: the installed app has its own storage. Then open the installed app and import the file there.

persistence.title: Storage protection
persistence.footer: Asks the browser not to clear your data when the device runs low on space.

import.tooLarge: This file is too large to import.
import.unsupported: This file was made by a newer version (schema {version}). Update Weeklid first.
import.invalid: This file cannot be imported ({reason}). Nothing was changed.
import.failed: Import failed ({reason}). Your data is unchanged.
import.verified: Imported and verified against what was stored (fingerprint {hash}).

verifyFailed.unreadable: Imported, but the stored data could not be read back. Export a copy and reload.
verifyFailed.mismatch: Imported, but the stored data differs from the file. Export a copy and check it.

counts.checkIns: no day wrap-ups | {count} day wrap-up | {count} day wrap-ups
counts.actuals: no records | {count} plan-vs-actual record | {count} plan-vs-actual records

import.replaceWarning: Importing replaces everything currently in this browser. Export first if you may need it.

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.footer: Removes your plan, tasks, day wrap-ups and backups from this device. This cannot be undone.
deleteAll.confirmBody: This permanently erases all Weeklid data on this device, including backups. Export a copy first if you may need it.
deleteAll.failed: Could not delete ({reason}). Nothing was changed.

changedElsewhere: Your data changed in the meantime, so nothing was replaced. Please try again.
